<thought>The spectrum shows a series of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da apart with intensities decreasing roughly by a factor of 10 each step (M+1 ≈ 11 % of M, M+2 ≈ 1 % of M). This pattern matches the natural 13C isotopic distribution for a molecule containing about 10 C atoms. No characteristic 2:1 (Cl) or 1:1 (Br) patterns are present, and the M+2 intensity is far lower than expected for sulfur or chlorine. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
